description: Suijin v3.13.0: FULL KERNEL AUDIT — 7 real bugs found and fixed: (1) purity linter globbed a nonexistent path, vacuously green since Phase 1; (2) kernel→modules inversion in controller (now dependency-inverted via enabled_check injection); (3) Journal flush lost entries racing the write (atomic drain + disk-failure requeue + drop accounting); (4) stale compiled core after cargo rebuild (mtime freshness); (5) event re-entrancy could blow the stack (depth-bounded); (6) LayeredConfig shallow merge wiped sibling keys (deep merge); (7) VFS rejected its own workspace root (absolute-path symlink normalization — macOS /tmp→/private/tmp). Packs fully self-contained (_packbridge seam deleted). 1029 tests green, 179 kernel.
